overview: 关系型数据库作为系统的主存储，持久化所有业务数据。在微服务共享数据库架构下，所有服务（Student Service、Class Service、Grade Service、Statistics Service、API Gateway）共同访问同一关系型数据库实例。数据库包含五张核心业务表：users（用户认证）、students（学生信息）、classes（班级信息）、grades（年级信息）和 study_records（学习记录）。数据库层面不设跨表外键约束，各表之间的引用完整性由应用层（微服务）通过 REST 调用校验保证，以保持服务间的松耦合。索引策略覆盖所有高频查询和筛选场景，包括唯一索引（学号、年级名称、用户名）、单列索引（班级 ID、名称、科目、日期）和联合索引（学生+科目+日期）。系统采用连接池管理数据库连接，所有写操作均在事务中执行，读操作支持读写分离以提升查询性能。SQL 聚合查询（COUNT、SUM、AVG、MAX、MIN）用于实时统计数据计算，不采用预聚合持久化策略，保证数据源始终为最新。

data_models.name: users
data_models.description: 用户认证信息表，存储系统所有用户的登录凭据和角色信息。API Gateway 在处理登录请求时校验此表。password 字段存储加密后的密码哈希值（非明文），role 字段控制用户权限范围。username 建立唯一索引确保用户名不重复。

fields.description: 主键，自增，用户唯一标识

fields.name: username
fields.description: 用户名，必填，全局唯一，建立 UNIQUE INDEX

fields.name: password
fields.description: 密码哈希值（BCrypt 加密），非明文存储

fields.name: role
fields.description: 角色枚举: admin|teacher|student，控制权限范围

fields.name: name
fields.description: 用户显示姓名

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: 记录创建时间，默认 CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: 记录更新时间，默认 CURRENT_TIMESTAMP，ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

data_models.name: students

fields.name: id
fields.description: 主键，自增，学生唯一标识

fields.name: name
fields.description: 学生姓名，不可为空

fields.name: student_no
fields.description: 学号，全局唯一，建立 UNIQUE INDEX

fields.name: contact_phone
fields.description: 联系电话，不可为空

fields.name: contact_email
fields.description: 联系邮箱，不可为空

fields.name: class_id

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: 记录更新时间，默认 CURRENT_TIMESTAMP，ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

data_models.name: classes
data_models.description: 班级基本信息主表，存储所有班级的核心属性。grade_id 为关联年级的逻辑外键，通过应用层调用 Grade Service 校验年级存在性，数据库层面不设外键约束。student_count 不作为持久化字段，查询时通过 COUNT 聚合 students 表按 class_id 分组实时计算。配合 idx_grade_id 索引加速按年级筛选，idx_name 索引加速按名称模糊搜索。

fields.name: name
fields.description: 班级名称，不可为空

fields.name: grade_id

fields.name: description

data_models.name: grades

interfaces.name: 数据库连接池
interfaces.description: 系统使用 HikariCP 连接池管理数据库连接。连接池配置：初始连接数 10，最小空闲连接数 5，最大连接数 50，连接超时 30 秒，空闲超时 10 分钟，最大生命周期 30 分钟。所有服务共享同一数据源配置。连接池提供读/写分离能力——写操作路由到主库，聚合查询（如统计计算）可路由到只读从库以分摊读压力。连接有效性检测使用心跳 SQL（SELECT 1），间隔 60 秒。

parameters.name: jdbc_url
parameters.description: JDBC 连接 URL，包含主机、端口、数据库名及连接参数（useSSL=true&characterEncoding=utf8mb4&serverTimezone=Asia/Shanghai）

parameters.name: pool_name
parameters.description: 连接池名称，用于监控区分

parameters.name: maximum_pool_size
parameters.description: 最大连接数，默认 50

parameters.name: connection_timeout
parameters.description: 连接超时时间（毫秒），默认 30000

interfaces.contract_ref: SAD contracts - Relational Database (shared datastore for all services)

interfaces.name: 事务管理
interfaces.description: 所有写操作（INSERT、UPDATE、DELETE）均在事务中执行。事务传播行为采用 REQUIRED（支持当前事务，不存在则创建新事务）。隔离级别采用 READ_COMMITTED（读已提交），避免脏读同时保持较好的并发性能。事务超时默认 10 秒。Service 层的 @Transactional 注解管理事务边界，确保一组数据库操作要么全部成功提交，要么全部回滚。跨服务的分布式事务由应用层通过最终一致性保证，不采用 XA 分布式事务。

parameters.name: propagation
parameters.description: 事务传播行为: REQUIRED

parameters.name: isolation
parameters.description: 事务隔离级别: READ_COMMITTED

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: 事务超时时间（秒），默认 10

parameters.name: rollback_for
parameters.description: 触发回滚的异常类型: Exception.class

interfaces.name: 学生信息 CRUD 操作
interfaces.description: Student Service 对 students 表执行的标准 CRUD 操作集。INSERT 操作包含学号唯一性校验（捕获唯一索引冲突异常转化为 409 响应）。UPDATE 操作按 id 定位，仅更新非空字段。DELETE 操作为物理删除。SELECT 支持按 name（LIKE 模糊匹配）、student_no（精确匹配）、class_id（精确匹配）组合条件，配合分页（LIMIT + OFFSET）和 COUNT 查询总数。

parameters.name: INSERT
parameters.description: INSERT INTO students (name, student_no, contact_phone, contact_email, class_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW(), NOW())

parameters.name: UPDATE
parameters.description: UPDATE students SET name=?, contact_phone=?, contact_email=?, class_id=?, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=?

parameters.name: DELETE
parameters.description: DELETE FROM students WHERE id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_BY_ID
parameters.description: SELECT id, name, student_no, contact_phone, contact_email, class_id, created_at, updated_at FROM students WHERE id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_LIST
parameters.description: SELECT id, name, student_no, contact_phone, contact_email, class_id, created_at FROM students WHERE 1=1 AND name LIKE ? AND student_no=? AND class_id=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

parameters.name: SELECT_COUNT
parameters.description: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE 1=1 AND name LIKE ? AND student_no=? AND class_id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_BY_CLASS_ID
parameters.description: SELECT id, name, student_no, contact_phone, contact_email FROM students WHERE class_id=? ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

parameters.name: SELECT_COUNT_BY_CLASS_ID
parameters.description: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students WHERE class_id=?

interfaces.name: 班级信息 CRUD 操作
interfaces.description: Class Service 对 classes 表执行的标准 CRUD 操作集。student_count 在列表查询和详情查询时通过子查询或关联查询实时计算，不持久化。DELETE 操作为物理删除。SELECT 支持按 name（LIKE 模糊匹配）和 grade_id（精确匹配）筛选，配合分页。

parameters.name: INSERT
parameters.description: INSERT INTO classes (name, grade_id, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, NOW(), NOW())

parameters.name: UPDATE
parameters.description: UPDATE classes SET name=?, grade_id=?, description=?, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=?

parameters.name: DELETE
parameters.description: DELETE FROM classes WHERE id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_BY_ID
parameters.description: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.grade_id, c.description, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.class_id=c.id) AS student_count FROM classes c WHERE c.id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_LIST
parameters.description: SELECT c.id, c.name, c.grade_id, c.description, c.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.class_id=c.id) AS student_count FROM classes c WHERE 1=1 AND c.name LIKE ? AND c.grade_id=? ORDER BY c.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

parameters.name: SELECT_COUNT
parameters.description: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classes WHERE 1=1 AND name LIKE ? AND grade_id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_BY_GRADE_ID
parameters.description: SELECT c.id AS class_id, c.name AS class_name, c.description, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM students s WHERE s.class_id=c.id) AS student_count FROM classes c WHERE c.grade_id=?

parameters.name: EXISTS_BY_ID
parameters.description: SELECT id, name FROM classes WHERE id=?

interfaces.name: 年级信息 CRUD 操作
interfaces.description: Grade Service 对 grades 表执行的标准 CRUD 操作集。class_count 在列表查询时通过关联聚合查询实时计算。INSERT 操作包含名称唯一性校验（捕获唯一索引冲突异常转化为 409 响应）。DELETE 操作为物理删除。

parameters.name: INSERT
parameters.description: INSERT INTO grades (name, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (?, ?, NOW(), NOW())

parameters.name: UPDATE
parameters.description: UPDATE grades SET name=?, description=?, updated_at=NOW() WHERE id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_BY_ID
parameters.description: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.description, g.created_at, g.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classes c WHERE c.grade_id=g.id) AS class_count FROM grades g WHERE g.id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_LIST
parameters.description: SELECT g.id, g.name, g.description, g.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM classes c WHERE c.grade_id=g.id) AS class_count FROM grades g ORDER BY g.id DESC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

parameters.name: SELECT_COUNT
parameters.description: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM grades

parameters.name: EXISTS_BY_ID
parameters.description: SELECT id, name FROM grades WHERE id=?

interfaces.name: 学习记录 CRUD + 聚合查询操作
interfaces.description: Statistics Service 对 study_records 表的操作集，包括学习记录的写入和多种维度的聚合统计查询。所有统计通过 SQL 聚合函数实时计算：学生维度（AVG、SUM、MAX、MIN、COUNT 按 subject 分组）、班级维度（通过关联 students 表获取班级下所有学生的成绩记录后进行聚合）、年级维度（通过关联 classes 和 students 表获取年级下所有学生的成绩记录后聚合）。支持可选的日期范围过滤和科目筛选。

parameters.name: INSERT
parameters.description: INSERT INTO study_records (student_id, subject, score, record_date, remarks, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NOW())

parameters.name: SELECT_STUDENT_STATS
parameters.description: SELECT subject, SUM(score) AS total_scores, AVG(score) AS average_score, MAX(score) AS max_score, MIN(score) AS min_score, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM study_records WHERE student_id=? AND record_date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY subject

parameters.name: SELECT_STUDENT_OVERALL_AVG
parameters.description: SELECT AVG(score) AS overall_average FROM study_records WHERE student_id=? AND record_date BETWEEN ? AND ?

parameters.name: SELECT_CLASS_STUDENT_IDS
parameters.description: SELECT id FROM students WHERE class_id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_CLASS_STATS
parameters.description: SELECT subject, AVG(score) AS class_average, MAX(score) AS highest_score, MIN(score) AS lowest_score, SUM(CASE WHEN score >= 60 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) * 100 AS pass_rate FROM study_records WHERE student_id IN (SELECT id FROM students WHERE class_id=?) AND subject=? AND record_date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY subject

parameters.name: SELECT_CLASS_OVERALL_AVG
parameters.description: SELECT AVG(score) AS class_average FROM study_records WHERE student_id IN (SELECT id FROM students WHERE class_id=?) AND record_date BETWEEN ? AND ?

parameters.name: SELECT_GRADE_CLASS_IDS
parameters.description: SELECT id, name FROM classes WHERE grade_id=?

parameters.name: SELECT_GRADE_STATS
parameters.description: SELECT c.id AS class_id, c.name AS class_name, AVG(sr.score) AS class_average, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS student_count FROM classes c LEFT JOIN students s ON s.class_id=c.id LEFT JOIN study_records sr ON sr.student_id=s.id WHERE c.grade_id=? GROUP BY c.id, c.name

parameters.name: SELECT_GRADE_OVERALL_AVG
parameters.description: SELECT AVG(score) FROM study_records WHERE student_id IN (SELECT s.id FROM students s JOIN classes c ON s.class_id=c.id WHERE c.grade_id=?) AND record_date BETWEEN ? AND ?

parameters.name: SELECT_CLASS_AVG_BY_GRADE
parameters.description: SELECT c.id AS class_id, c.name AS class_name, AVG(sr.score) AS class_average, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS student_count FROM classes c JOIN students s ON s.class_id=c.id JOIN study_records sr ON sr.student_id=s.id WHERE c.grade_id=? AND sr.subject=? AND sr.record_date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY c.id, c.name

interfaces.name: 数据库 DDL 初始化
interfaces.description: 系统首次启动时通过 DDL 脚本初始化数据库 schema，创建所有业务表和索引。使用 IF NOT EXISTS 保证幂等性。所有表使用 InnoDB 引擎，字符集 utf8mb4，排序规则 utf8mb4_unicode_ci。初始化脚本在应用启动时自动执行（通过 Flyway 或 Liquibase 管理版本化迁移）。

parameters.name: CREATE_USERS
parameters.description: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, username VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, password VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, role VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

parameters.name: CREATE_STUDENTS
parameters.description: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS students (id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, student_no VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, contact_phone VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, contact_email VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, class_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

parameters.name: CREATE_CLASSES
parameters.description: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS classes (id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, grade_id BIGINT DEFAULT NULL, description VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

parameters.name: CREATE_GRADES
parameters.description: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS grades (id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, description VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

parameters.name: CREATE_STUDY_RECORDS
parameters.description: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS study_records (id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, student_id BIGINT NOT NULL, subject VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, score DECIMAL(5,1) NOT NULL, record_date DATE NOT NULL, remarks VARCHAR(500) DEFAULT NULL, created_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

parameters.name: CREATE_UNIQUE_INDEXES
parameters.description: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_users_username ON users(username); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_student_no ON students(student_no); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_grades_name ON grades(name); CREATE INDEX idx_students_class_id ON students(class_id); CREATE INDEX idx_students_name ON students(name); CREATE INDEX idx_classes_grade_id ON classes(grade_id); CREATE INDEX idx_classes_name ON classes(name); CREATE INDEX idx_student_subject_date ON study_records(student_id, subject, record_date); CREATE INDEX idx_record_date ON study_records(record_date); CREATE INDEX idx_subject ON study_records(subject)

error_handling: Relational Database 按以下规则处理异常：1）连接失败——应用启动时数据库不可达或运行中连接中断时，连接池抛出异常，应用应重试连接并记录 ERROR 级日志，重试间隔 5 秒，最多重试 3 次后触发服务启动失败告警；2）唯一约束冲突——INSERT 或 UPDATE 操作违反 UNIQUE INDEX（学号重复、年级名称重复、用户名重复）时，数据库抛出 DuplicateKeyException 或 IntegrityConstraintViolationException，由各 Service 层捕获后转化为 409 Conflict HTTP 响应返回给调用方；3）死锁——并发写入产生死锁时（DeadlockLoserDataAccessException），数据库自动选择牺牲一个事务并回滚，应用层检测到死锁异常后自动重试当前事务最多 3 次，每次重试前随机等待 100-500ms 以降低再次冲突概率；4）查询超时——复杂聚合查询（如年级统计跨多表关联）超过配置的查询超时阈值（默认 10 秒）时抛出 QueryTimeoutException，由 Service 层捕获后记录 WARN 日志，返回 504 Gateway Timeout 响应并考虑添加索引优化或拆分查询；5）事务回滚——任何 RuntimeException 在事务方法内抛出时触发事务回滚（rollbackFor = Exception.class），保证数据一致性，回滚后不需要重试的分支返回 500 Internal Server Error 给调用方；6）连接池耗尽——所有连接被占用且等待超过 connectionTimeout（30 秒）时，连接池抛出 SQLException，由 Service 层捕获后返回 503 Service Unavailable 响应体为 {"error": "service_unavailable", "message": "数据库连接池已满，请稍后重试"}；7）数据截断——写入的字段长度超过表定义（如 VARCHAR(100) 写入超过 100 字符）时抛出 DataTruncation 异常，由 Service 层捕获后转化为 422 响应并提示具体字段超长；8）SQL 注入防御——所有 SQL 操作必须使用参数化查询（PreparedStatement / MyBatis #{param}）或 ORM 框架（MyBatis/Spring Data JPA），禁止字符串拼接 SQL。所有数据库操作记录慢查询日志，执行时间超过 1 秒的 SQL 输出 WARN 级日志，包含 SQL 文本、参数值和执行耗时，供后续 DBA 优化参考。
